presentation.label: Micro timing for the whole track
presentation.summary: TRACK TRIG EDIT row MICRO T. LEVEL sets every step on the selected audio or MIDI track to that micro timing.
presentation.overview: FUNC+BANK TRACK TRIG EDIT gains MICRO T under TRIGS. LEVEL rewrites every step of the selected track through the stock micro-timing writer. MIDI button off writes the audio track. MIDI button on writes the MIDI track only.
highlights: The window stays four rows. REC.TRG scrolls in below SWING.
LEVEL applies as it turns. There is no YES to confirm.
Audio and MIDI keep separate trigs. The footer uses the stock fraction.
usage: Grid record, then FUNC+BANK (FUNCTION on MKI). Highlight MICRO T, under TRIGS.
Turn LEVEL. The footer fraction moves, and every step on this track takes that micro timing.
Press the MIDI button and turn LEVEL again to set the MIDI track. The audio track keeps the value it already had.

access.location: FUNC+BANK > TRACK TRIG EDIT > MICRO T
steps: Grid record, then FUNC+BANK (FUNCTION on MKI). Highlight MICRO T, under TRIGS.

Press the MIDI button and turn LEVEL again to set the MIDI track. The audio track keeps the value it already had.

controls.name: MICRO T
controls.doc: Index 23 is on grid (0). 0 is -23 and 46 is +23, in stock micro-timing steps. LEVEL writes that absolute value to every step of the side on screen.

limitations: OS 1.40C. The reported pass is a private MICRO T9 card, not a build of this package. USB Keep/Undo and ot_emu are untested.
The remembered number is battery RAM. Power-off clears it. It is not stored in the project. Rewritten trigs stay in the pattern.
The next LEVEL turn sets all 64 steps, including empty ones. An individual trig edit does not move the row.

storage.label: ROM unit, menu detours and row-index pokes
storage.conditions: One ColdFire unit, thirteen detours, one LEVEL pointer and the TRACK TRIG EDIT index pokes. No DSP memory.

processing.label: ColdFire, while LEVEL turns on MICRO T
processing.conditions: Runs in the TRACK TRIG EDIT LEVEL handler when MICRO T is selected, then calls the stock per-trig writer for 64 steps. Nothing per sample.

impact.conditions: LEVEL on the MICRO T row writes 64 trigs through the stock setter. Other rows jump back to stock.

cpu.rationale: One pot turn walks all 64 steps through the stock writer. No per-audio-frame work.

dsp.rationale: No DSP code. Playback uses the trig words the stock writer stored.

memory.rationale: One ColdFire unit plus 512 battery bytes for the remembered number, cleared at power-off.

tests.summary: Author reported the private MICRO T9 card working for audio and MIDI separately. This module package is untested.
